semantic_level: C0, all content invented as explicit working hypotheses; no confirmed gloss

core_families.definition: The exact introductory word selects the fixed opaque referent Body C or Preparation Y. It asserts existence of that referent and binds owner, now-time tau, owner-relative ordinary reference norm. Repetition selects the identical referent, never a fresh per-line owner.

Exact licensed host+aiin constructs a ProfileField(owner,axis,norm,tau,mode). aiin converts a nominal property axis into an owner-bound predicable property and asserts/assumes owner has that property. It has a real eligibility/possession effect and supplies the field for following grades. Only okaiin, qokaiin, chokaiin, daiin and the separately paid okoaiin are licensed; no global parser. Exact q prefix in qokaiin opens a hypothetical antecedent; exact ch in chokaiin requires preceding world predicate and makes observation of the bound field an explicit consequent, closing the antecedent. Plain okaiin/daiin return to actual mode and close any prior antecedent.

Require retained owner and explicit current field; predicate HIGH/LOW/EQUABLE(owner,axis,norm,tau) in current actual/antecedent mode. HIGH and LOW are opposed only for same owner, axis, norm, time and actual condition. No g-negation rule.

Predicate one of the frozen quality kinds CLEAR,PALE,WARM,FINE,COHESIVE,SMOOTH on retained owner at tau, in current actual/antecedent mode. It is a world proposition about that owner, not a symbolic-record label.

Select Appearance/Substance/Surface axis of existing owner with unchanged norm/tau; exact parameter declares actual or antecedent mode. This does not itself assert a grade, cannot manufacture a fresh owner/basis. No implicit line switch.

Require last actual or antecedent proposition; exact forms assert its conjunction/implication with next world proposition through an explicit pending relation. A missing following proposition stays partial. No inert grammatical filler.

Require existing owner and last written world proposition; issue one of RETAIN,CLARIFY,APPLY instructions to that owner, explicitly using that proposition as its stated condition. These are hypothetical instructions, never an efficacy claim or an actual executed event.

Consume last written world proposition/instruction and assert it remains valid under retained owner/norm/tau/condition; lexical scope closure, never line reset or symbolic operation report. Repeats reaffirm the same world content.

Consume last written owner proposition and qualify it as persistent or restricted to stated current condition. No new time, source, owner or numerical basis is supplied; restrictions reference existing written condition.

An explicitly priced exact whole can run a finite declared sequence of preceding families in stated order. No productive concatenation license; every invoked part has a declared non-null effect. Pure whole residuals can invoke a family directly without any claim of meaningful internal glyph parts.

types.Basis: same owner-relative ordinary norm, no numerical cross-owner comparison
types.Proposition: world assertion/condition with Owner,Axis or Quality,Basis where graded,Time and provenance
types.Instruction: directive to same Owner with explicit written Proposition input

okoaiin.price: separate exact host internal-o extension, no global o rule

choldy.price: chol exact host introduced here as COHESIVE; no global ch/dy rule

reference_and_basis_policy: One explicit introduction per source unit; no owner donated by circle ownership. Body C is a C0 same-body hypothesis across rings, not identified Moon/Sun. Preparation Y is introduced by tosheo; no Moon-body causal transfer asserted.
The introductory whole also establishes Substance as starting current field, ACTUAL mode, tau and own ordinary norm: four paid ambient assignments.
Only explicit A_N_BIND/SELECT_FIELD changes axis/mode; paragraph line boundaries do nothing.
A_N_BIND shares typed operation across fields with differing axes; internal o in okoaiin means separate Substance host, not rising derivative.
Hypothetical antecedents are written predications but not actual opposite grades. A subsequent ACTUAL binding closes them; no retrospective repair.
Every nominal host is actual argument to aiin binding; opaque owners are arguments to all world predicates/instructions.
Unknown marked groups are UNKNOWN and block later derivation in that unit; remaining rows retain exact dictionary inventory only. No uncertainty normalization or automatic joins.

Fresh exact extensions may parameterize only frozen grades/qualities/actions/axes and compose these families; all residuals/aliases/defaults priced. No new family, time transition or causal bridge after freeze.
No automatic parsing of ordinary forms; invoked exact compounds state parts/effects. Other raw forms are whole residuals and all unexplained subparts remain charged.
prospective_contrast: okoaiin dal asserts substantial constitution HIGH; okaiin dalg asserts outward appearance LOW for same owner/time but different axes. This supplies a static two-axis rival without asserting a rise. qokaiin can make an appearance HIGH antecedent while okaiin makes appearance LOW actual. No LOW_BUT_RISING predication unless separately written within frozen vocabulary, which has no change constructor.
extension_policy: Immutable core families/types/constants/policy. Missing written inputs or native uncertainties yield partial; no repaired core.
